submission.justification: Absorber-F3 with 4mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.18% at 100 GeV, outperforming both Absorber-F1 (3.855% at 4mm) and Absorber-F2 (5.093% at 5mm). This configuration meets all safety constraints with the residual dose rate requirement satisfied, and the plate thickness is within the specified 2-10mm range. The optimization showed that 4mm is optimal for F3, providing better resolution than the baseline 5mm thickness (3.198%).
